attempts.error: Package file closure mismatch: copied package contained scripts/__pycache__/cn_law_normalizer.cpython-312.pyc and scripts/__pycache__/stage3_checker.cpython-312.pyc.
attempts.cause: A pre-H13 direct --help inspection invoked the archived Python entry without bytecode suppression and created two untracked cache files beside the committed package scripts before the copy.
attempts.evidenceIntegrity: The committed R7 package bytes and manifest were not modified. The two cache files were untracked runtime byproducts and the closure verifier rejected them rather than ignoring them.
attempts.correction: Record the failure, remove only the verified generated cache directory and failed temporary copy, verify the committed package closure, then repeat in a new directory with Python -B so direct package consumption is read-only.
attempts.claimImpact: The first portability attempt failed. A later clean attempt may establish only the explicitly documented Python -B direct-use path; ordinary skvm run still deploys a workdir-local skill copy.
